description: Dataset of IEEE and Synthetic Power System Test Cases (used in Oriol Cartiel's PhD) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Oriol Cartiel Arasa, Luis Sainz (Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya). The data used in my PhD thesis originate from publicly available internet repositories (see references within the files). The dataset is based on detailed information from both IEEE n-bus test power systems and synthetic power grid test cases developed by the scientific community. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
